However, the global health landscape has shown that while some years may see multiple new PHEICs, others may see none or only one. Given the ongoing efforts in global health surveillance and response, it is reasonable to estimate a moderate probability for no new PHEICs, a slightly lower probability for one new PHEIC, and a similar probability for two or more new PHEICs, reflecting the uncertainty and potential for emerging infectious diseases.
